name: Tombstone Begins

features.name: Sticky Win Respins
features.description: Winning symbols and their copies stay put.

features.name: Unleash
features.description: All revolvers fire their remaining bullets.

review:
Tombstone Begins is a 4-5-5-5-4 western prequel built on sticky Win Respins: winning symbols, and every other instance of them on the grid, stay put while the rest respins.

Revolvers fire bullets across the board. An Unleash symbol makes them fire all their remaining shots, and a Refill symbol reloads them to six. xSplit and xNudge also appear. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 20,000x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
